title: Multipart
shortDescription: Uploading large files in parts using multipart upload
metaDescription: All available methods for multipart object uploads in VK Object Storage: initializing an upload (CreateMultipartUpload), uploading object parts (UploadPart), completing an upload (CompleteMultipartUpload), aborting an upload (AbortMultipartUpload), retrieving a list of uploaded parts (ListParts)
